text:
sara_sales: Quick sync — prospect (FinReg Inc) wants firm answers on BYOK/HSM: attestation that keys never leave the HSM, rotation windows, and the pricing delta if they bring their own keys. Procurement call tomorrow 3pm PT. Can we get a short blurb + ballpark numbers by EOD?

ben_sec: They specifically asked for FIPS 140-2/3 cert + statement about key material residency. I can draft an attestation note. Do we have a redacted HSM attestation we can share? :thinking_face:

liz_field_eng: I can run a quick BYOK smoke on staging and capture latency and auth flow. For the procurement doc we should include: network whitelisting, IPs, expected latency delta, and POC steps.

raj_sre: Important: if we do a proxy to customer HSM, expect ~15-25ms added per token request (roundtrip + TLS). If they require multi-AZ failover to a remote HSM, add another 10-40ms depending on region egress. Also need VPN/peering or static IP allowlist.

anna_legal: Procurement will want proof-of-destruction language and a clause about key escrow — are we offering escrow for this customer? If not, we need a clear "no escrow" statement and steps for key handoff if they terminate.

liz_field_eng: Proposed POC plan (short):
- Week 0: legal/ops signoff + whitelist
- Week 1: BYOK smoke (key import, wrap/unWrap, basic generate)
- Week 2: perf + latency benchmarks, 24h soak (sample traffic)
- Deliverable: one-pager with latency numbers, token cost delta, and short runbook for cutover.

liz_field_eng: Quick test command I used for smoke (staging env):
```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://staging.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY" \\n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\n  -d '{"model":"redwood-small","input":"latency test","kms_key_id":"projects/prod/keys/customer-123"}'
```
(we'll redact key ids for the doc)

ben_sec: I have a redacted attestation we can share, includes FIPS status + HSM vendor audit. I'll tidy it for public delivery and drop in drive. Also: rotation — we support customer-initiated rotation; default rotation window is 30 days but we can accommodate shorter windows in SOW.

raj_sre: Action items for network: customer must open outbound to our staging IPs on 443 and allow our collector IP for metrics. I'll send the IP list. Also ask them if they need private link.

anna_legal: For contract language I'll prepare two options: (A) standard no-escrow + customer responsibility for key backup; (B) optional escrow addendum with additional fees and SLA. Need to know which procurement path they prefer.

sara_sales: Pricing ask: they want a delta vs hosted default — what's the rough monthly premium for BYOK with HSM-backed keys for ~100k tokens/day and dedicated throughput? ballpark numbers only pls.

liz_field_eng: Ballpark: BYOK + HSM proxy adds about 8-12% perf overhead => marginal cost up ~10-20% depending on batching. Dedicated throughput/reserved GPUs is a separate line item. For 100k tokens/day, estimate $X-$Y/month (I’ll let finance ops give real numbers).

ben_sec: Also note there's an ops onboarding fee for BYOK/HSM (one-time) to cover attestation+runbook (~1-3k typical; exact depends on scope).

sara_sales: OK — @ben_sec please drop attestation pdf and a 2-3 sentence summary. @liz_field_eng @raj_sre please produce a 1-page latency + network checklist. @anna_legal please draft the two contract options. I'll consolidate into a procurement-ready email. Can we hit EOD? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

liz_field_eng: Yep — will post the 1-pager here by 5pm PT.

raj_sre: I'll post the IPs and the VPN/peering checklist by 4pm PT.

ben_sec: Attestation draft will be in Drive link (redact pending) by 5:30pm PT.

anna_legal: Draft clauses by EOD as well.

deploy-bot: staging-byok-proxy deployed ✅ https://staging.redwood.ai/ops/instances/xyZ — creds sent to secure channel.

sara_sales: Perfect, thanks everyone — I'll prep the procurement email after your drops and loop in the customer. :pray:
